attributes.probed_form: RETAINED, three edits composing into one lever (commit 6d219dba0). (1) THE FMR FUNNEL. At all fifteen inner clamp sites, replace the block-scoped temp `{ f32 fv = tN * sc; if (fv < lo) { fv = lo; } else if (fv > hi) { fv = hi; } q->p_parms[K].i.FIELD = fv; }` with in-place clamping of the already-function-scope value: `tN = tN * sc; if (tN < lo) { tN = lo; } else if (tN > hi) { tN = hi; } q->p_parms[K].i.FIELD = tN;`. Four identically-named block-scoped `fv` locals in disjoint scopes share ONE register home, so every clamped value had to be copied into it; in-place clamping gives each value its own web. Alone: real 462 -> 610, insns 843 -> 833, multiset 32t -> 22t, and the ENTIRE ours-only fmr class (10 words) disappears, leaving ours exactly 10 short = the 10 target-only b. (2) THE BRANCH PAIRS. At all five outer clamp groups, replace the statement nest `t3 = t3 * sc; if (t3 < lo) { } else { if (t3 > hi) { } else { hi = t3; } lo = hi; }` (and the v1 half-converted variant `if (!(t3 < lo)) { hi = (t3 > hi) ? hi : t3; lo = hi; }`) with the nested ternary `t3 = t3 * sc; lo = (t3 < lo) ? lo : (hi = (t3 > hi) ? hi : t3);`. On top of (1): multiset 22t -> 5t, insns 833 -> 840. (3) THE COALESCING. Hoist `f32 sc, lo, hi;` from the five block scopes to function scope, immediately after `f32 t0, t1, t2, t3;`, leaving `sc = pif[N]; lo = pif[N+1]; hi = pif[N+2];` as assignments. On top of (1)+(2): multiset 5t -> 1t, target-only opcodes NONE, insns 840 -> 844. FOUR MEASURED NEGATIVES on the surviving first-group cluster, all NO structural movement: (a) declaration order `f32 lo, hi, sc;` - byte-identical (real 497, 844, 1t); (b) declaring sc/lo/hi BEFORE t0..t3 - real 497 -> 501, structure unchanged; (c) moving the real assignment into the inner else arm, `lo = (t3 < lo) ? lo : ((t3 > hi) ? hi : (hi = t3));` - real 497 -> 557, structure unchanged; (d) forcing a read of hi's home with a comma operator, `lo = (t3 < lo) ? lo : (hi = (t3 > hi) ? hi : t3, hi);` - real 497 -> 637, insns 848, multiset 5t, and it reloaded hi (ours-only -4 lfs -1 stfs). TWO MORE on the pragma axis: `#pragma opt_lifetimes off` scoped around the function - real 634, insns 847, multiset 6t; `#pragma opt_lifetimes on` - NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL, object bytes unchanged, i.e. the default already behaves as `on` and the pragma axis is null in both directions.
attributes.residual: real 497, insns T843/O844, opcode multiset 1t with TARGET-ONLY EMPTY, and regnorm GENUINE structural rows 11 -> 1. The single genuine row is one surplus `fmr` in the FIRST clamp group only (@0x5e8-0x600): ours emits `fcmpo f6,f1 / bge / fmr f0,f1 / b / fcmpo f6,f5 / ble / fmr f0,f5 / b / fmr f0,f6` - three arm copies into a fresh scratch FPR f0 (freed when `sc` dies) - where the target emits `fcmpo f1,f5 / bge / b / fcmpo f1,f0 / ble / b / fmr f0,f1 / fmr f5,f0`, coalescing the outer ternary's result into lo's home f5 and the inner's into hi's home f0 so that BOTH identity arms are empty and cost only their `b`. Groups 2-5 reproduce the target shape exactly. The mechanism is stated and machine-confirmed by prediction in claim.law.MB_ternary-result-coalesces-with-its-destination-only-after-the-first-assignment-in-scope.20260901.v1. NOT WEBFRANK-ELIGIBLE: the residual is a surplus INSTRUCTION, not a register field, and the postprocessor cannot delete a word. The other two residual rows are non-genuine: a 6-instruction rotation of `addi r5,r5,300` (ours @0xc4, target @0xdc, both streams contain it - SCHEDULE class, untouched this run) and one sdata2 pool-name row (`@76` vs `lbl_80349154`), which is the score-invisible naming class. AGAINST V1'S ARBITRATION ADVICE: v1 reverted the outer ternary to protect count parity 843/843, reasoning that identical instruction shape is the recolor precondition. That reasoning was right in aim and wrong in application - the 843/843 parity was an ACCIDENT of 10 surplus fmr exactly cancelling 10 missing b, i.e. 20 words that can never be recolored. Equal COUNT is not the recolor precondition; equal SHAPE is. The 843/844 state, one word from parity with an empty target-only set, is far closer to a rule than the parity state was.
